lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Reordering sign-in showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path layout changes did not improve conversion across 2 tests, with major changes hurting performance.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, adoption/redesign, choose_path/copy, choose_path/redesign, finish/hint, finish/redesign, home/hint, and sign_in/copy, as each has only 1 test.

candidates.title: Redesign Upload Photos Stage with Mascot Guidance
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload screen using a stage layout featuring live mascot tips and clear framing guidelines.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with high completion time.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit front-facing photos for the best custom desktop pet generation results.

components.text: Make sure pet eyes and face are clearly visible!

guard.reason: Valid redesign of photo upload screen with mascot guidance.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 39.1% of users, but full redesigns are expensive and have limited historical backing.

candidates.title: Add Desktop Companion Playground Intro Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new introductory screen before home intro showing how the pet lives on the desktop screen overlay.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and 3 support tickets mentioned confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet.

new_desktop_playground.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_playground.body: Your pet walks across your screen, responds to clicks, and sits on active windows.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your desktop companion is active. Enjoy having your new pet alongside your daily work.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an introductory screen before home intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens hurt conversion (-1.7%) in prior tests and has high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Redesign Sign In Screen with Account Persistence Notice
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen with a spotlight layout emphasizing account binding so pets are saved permanently.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Bind Your Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to ensure your customized pet status and progress are preserved across logins and app updates.
sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet safely to your primary profile.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of sign-in screen highlighting account persistence.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the top support complaint theme, though full screen redesign carries risk.

candidates.title: Preset Mascot Fast Track Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Add a preset pet selection fast-track screen for users who prefer skipping photo upload entirely.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s, leading to a 60.9% step conversion.

new_preset_quickstart.headline: Choose a Ready-to-Adopt Pet
new_preset_quickstart.body: Select one of our pre-crafted desktop pets to get started instantly.

pick_friend.headline: Select Your Adoption Style
pick_friend.body: Create a custom pet from photos or choose an instant pre-made companion.

guard.reason: Makes the photo upload step skippable, which violates Rule 1.

candidates.title: Redesign Waiting Screen with Interactive Mascot Tips
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a checklist layout showing active background generation steps and overlay tips.
candidates.why: Home wait time is very high (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to show up on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet Overlay
waiting.body: We are preparing your pet graphics and calibrating desktop window interactions.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of waiting screen showing pet creation progress.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info tests consistently failed to show clear positive impact across 3 iterations.

candidates.title: Desktop Support System Requirements Hint
candidates.change: Display a system overlay compatibility hint on the path selection screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet not displaying on desktop or app failing to launch, while initial step loses ~24% of users.

choose_path.hint: Compatible with Windows 10/11 & macOS. Pet overlay runs seamlessly alongside open windows.

guard.reason: Valid system compatibility hint added to path selection screen.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config change, but hint modifications have historically shown slightly negative results.

candidates.title: Cloud Sync Pet Protection Sign-In Headline
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to stress permanent cloud pet protection against profile loss.
candidates.why: Sign-in step converts at 72.9% and 8 support messages reported pet reset issues after re-login.

sign_in.headline: Protect Your Pet with Cloud Sync
sign_in.body: Connect your account now so your pet companion stays safely backed up whenever you sign back in.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost text change addressing top support ticket issue with positive past copy test signal.

candidates.title: Adopted Pet Accessories Bundle Banner
candidates.change: Add an accessory starter gift badge on the adoption certificate screen to encourage finalizing setup.
candidates.why: Adoption completion rate drops to 60.9% and users take considerable time on this step.

components.text: Includes Free Starter Toy & Snack Bundle

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions gifts or free extras, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Split View Layout for Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Reformat the home intro screen into a split layout separating welcome text from quick desktop interaction steps.
candidates.why: Finish conversion is 64.8% with long drop times (median 395s), and users report confusion around controlling the pet.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Workspace
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on screen at any time to open quick actions, change behaviors, or hide companion.

guard.reason: Valid split view redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Layout adjustments previously decreased step conversion (-2.0%) across 2 tests.

candidates.title: Desktop App Launch Troubleshooting Notification
candidates.change: Enable notification updates on the waiting screen with direct instructions if screen display takes longer than expected.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes high median time (201s) and support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on screen.

waiting.hint: If pet does not appear on your screen when ready, check your taskbar or app permissions.

guard.reason: Valid addition of ready notification and troubleshooting hint to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost notification update, though target step conversion is already relatively high (81.3%).
